title: Florida Karen Lives Up to Her Name
description:
A woman is facing multiple charges after a fender-bender in Surfside, Florida on April 15, 2024. Police took Karen Monroydeleon, 25, into custody after she allegedly pushed and kicked at officers after the crash, according to the Bal Harbour Police Department. A police report shows, investigators found several knives and two empty bottles of an alcoholic beverage when searching Karen’s car. She is facing charges of DUI, battery on a LEO, and careless driving. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
